ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $ \triangle ABC$, $ AB=AC$, points E, F are on side BC, and $ \angle EAF=\angle C$. $ \triangle ABF\sim \triangle ECA$; if $ BF=8$ and $ CE=6$, find the length of AB.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle ABF\sim \triangle ECA$, \\
we have $\frac{AB}{EC}=\frac{BF}{AC}$, \\
Since $BF=8$, $CE=6$, $AB=AC$, \\
it follows that $\frac{AB}{6}=\frac{8}{AB}$, that is $AB^{2}=6\times 8=48$, \\
Hence, $AB=\boxed{4\sqrt{3}}$ (negative value discarded).
